intelligence.research_summary: Velocity’s thesis – chase momentum and volume acceleration – faltered because the market’s momentum was weak and volume acceleration was negative, leading to higher adverse‑selection costs.  The Market Maker’s focus on spread rent and completion probability paid off: its larger inventory and higher fill probabilities mitigated adverse selection while still capturing spread rent.  Both wallets are heavily exposed to the same core items, but the Market Maker’s higher liquidity score and better fill probability give it a clear advantage in the current regime.
intelligence.summary: The market shows a slight downward drift with high turnover concentrated in a few premium items such as the Scythe of Vitur and Twisted Bow.  Velocity’s momentum‑driven strategy underperformed, losing 14 % in the period, while the Market Maker’s spread‑capture approach yielded a 4.6 % loss, outperforming Velocity by a wide margin.  Both wallets hold similar core positions (Ruby ring, Cemetery teleport, Guthix rest, etc.) but the Market Maker’s larger inventory and higher fill probabilities give it an edge in adverse‑selection control.
